snippet.title: Reina & Jericho - PAX Indie Showcase Trailer
snippet.description:
Reina & Jericho is an upcoming story-driven Metroidvania with  intense melee combat and fast-paced platforming.  Defy the laws of cause and effect with time travel mechanics that impact all aspects of the game.  Create a perfect chain of events that will lead Reina to freedom.

Be sure to check out Reina & Jericho at the PAX East online indie showcase, and wishlist us on steam here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1157800/Reina_and_Jericho/

Reina & Jericho is planned for release in 2021 on PC (Steam, Itch.io), Nintendo Switch, PS5, and Xbox Series X|S, with more platforms to follow!

Find a way.
